newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil judge rules for gov't over CVRD.
newsitem.headline: Brazil judge rules for gov't over CVRD.

text.p: A high court judge has ruled in favour of the Brazilian government and revoked injunctions blocking the sale of mining group Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD), a court official said.
The official of the Superior Court of Justice in Brasilia said Justice Democrito Reinaldo's ruling "suspends the injunctions which were among the 27 cases he was studying."
The judge named a federal court in Rio as the tribunal to rule on the merit itself of the cases.
The government petition argued that all lawsuits against the CVRD sale should be considered by a single tribunal because of a conflict of interpretation among lower courts.

It was unclear whether or not the ruling meant a green light for the auction to take place immediately because of reports of a new injunction being issued in Rio, which was not among the cases Justice Reinaldo studied.

A spokesman for the National Development Bank said he had not been able to confirm the judge's ruling yet, but said that, in certain circumstances, it might mean the auction going ahead immediately. The bank earlier rescheduled the sale for Tuesday.
